read.en: Lumentum rose 0.5% on Oct 23 to $756.17, trading between $736.01 and $788.90. It is below the falling 5-day ($803.3), 10-day ($859.0), 30-day ($940.0) and 100-day ($869.6) averages and the rising 200-day ($788.0). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and is below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($969.14), and RSI is 35.
read.zh: Lumentum 10月23日上涨 0.5%，收于 $756.17，盘中区间 $736.01–788.90。股价位于下行的 5 日（$803.3）、10 日（$859.0）、30 日（$940.0）和 100 日均线（$869.6）以及上行的 200 日均线（$788.0）下方。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线及零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$969.14），RSI 为 35。

read.en: The $736 low undercut Wednesday's $746.2 low, and the $788.9 high tagged the 200-day ($788.0) and the $784.5–787 August lows before fading. Resistance is $784.5–788.9, then $800–819 (Oct 15 low, 5-day, Sep 3 low) and $832. Support is $736–746 (Oct 22–23 lows), then $680.4 and $650.8 (July lows). A close above $789 would target $803–819; a close below $736 would open $680.

r.en: 200-day average $788.0; Aug 11 and Aug 24 lows ($784.5–787.0); Oct 23 high $788.9
